umap.note: (snapshot, neuron, xy) Hellinger-UMAP of the shown neurons' embeddings, warm-started backwards from the final snapshot and Procrustes-aligned

graph.note: edges (src, dst, weight) concatenated over graph snapshots (n_edges each, strongest first); nodes 0..n-1 = shown neurons (neurons.ids order), n..n+B-1 = boundary pixels; only active edges (w > 2 w_min); layout: neurons at UMAP coords of snapshot umap_snapshot, or (pixels) Tutte/harmonic position H @ pixel_xy plus jitter sd 0.12 px
